author: N6rL
content: Decision: Option D — vault note filename is the normalized name; source file is provenance only. raw_identifier stores original path as audit trail; staleness on user rename is acceptable (KO is self-contained in Library after ingest). Re-ingest of renamed file hits ExactMatch on content_hash; raw_identifier update is a future concern (M2+). No filesystem mutation by Source plugin. Closing.
